a.lede: The platform's Discoverable Servers are about to get a lot more discoverable.
a.title: Discord public server messages may be soon searchable on Google, but you can opt out

b.lede: Discord will allow search engines to index discussions in Discoverable Servers and make them accessible on the web to users outside the platform without an account or invitation. [...]
b.title: Discord to let search engines index public server messages
